svg.title: Roll your git history into a character sheet — then read the dossier on the back
svg.desc: A git commit graph feeding an RPG character sheet whose XP bars sit under a targeting crosshair — the same data as fun stats and as a recon dossier. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Roll your git history into a character sheet — then read the dossier on the back”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 475292498.
